verdict.rationale: Flagsmith documents multivariate flags with multiple percentage-weighted variants (A/B/n) and uses them to serve feature variations in Experimentation. The docs also position it as managing 'feature flags and remote config', so dynamic non-boolean values are part of the product. missing for 10: explicit documentation of the supported value types (strings, numbers, JSON) and how SDKs read them, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of remote config use.
